method: One batch, all 254 source NPIs, no header: NPI, source street1, city, state, ZIP. Suite in street1 retained; separate street2 not submitted and remains in source. No manual address repair, guessed coordinates, nearest city or population filter. curl --form addressFile=@addresses.csv --form benchmark=4 ENDPOINT --output geocodes.csv. Response retains exact submitted-address echo, match quality, matched address and interpolated point where provided.
limitations: Current benchmark retrieved after the evidence cutoff is used only for mapping historical registered addresses, not 2026 clinical measurement. Exact is a Census address-range match, not a verified structure, suite, historical provider location or treatment site. Non-exact, No_Match and Tie remain review states. Public professional addresses only; no patient data submitted.
